systems.system: National ID system (national population registry, national ID number and smartcard)
systems.owner: National Identification Authority (NIDA), Ministry of Home Affairs
systems.tiers: national; about 14.7 million of a targeted 25 million citizens registered as of mid-2018

note: For Tanzania the document describes the national ID system only; of civil registration it says that RITA is responsible for it and gives birth registration coverage figures, and states nothing on how or where a birth or death is recorded.
